name: dshpilot
description: DSHPilot — Desktop Workstation for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @dshpilot/desktop-host build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-plugin-desktop build && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-client-desktop build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dshpilot/desktop-host typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-plugin-desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter @dshpilot/dsh-client-desktop typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:scripts
